notes: The list is essentially complete. Chaminade's original violin-and-piano output is small: Capriccio Op. 18, Trois morceaux Op. 31 and Rondeau Op. 97, plus Kreisler's established Sérénade espagnole. Other violin versions I know of are publishers' arrangements (e.g. Pas des écharpes, the Flute Concertino Op. 107 and Sérénade aux étoiles Op. 142, both originally for flute). None is an established violinist's arrangement, so I added nothing rather than risk inventing works.
